Copper alloy Coin. Nummus, possibly of House of Valentinian, possibly Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: possibly Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: SECVRIT[AS REI PVBLICAE].
